preconditions.description: The number of rounds n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 and name.islower() for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each player's name must be a string of lower-case Latin letters with a length from 1 to 32.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= score <= 1000 for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each score must be an integer between -1000 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the name of the player who wins the game.
